core_problem_solved: To provide a set of powerful extensions to the standard Java Collections Framework, introducing concepts like immutable collections and new collection types (e.g., Multimap, BiMap) that were not available in the JDK.
key_features: New collection types like `Multimap` (one key, multiple values) and `BiMap` (bidirectional map)
era_and_niche: The original, pioneering collections library from Google, released in the late 2000s. It set a new standard for Java utility libraries and heavily influenced later versions of the JDK.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. The project was officially renamed and significantly expanded to become the **Google Guava** library. The direct and official successor is **`com.google.guava:guava`**. All projects using `google-collections` must migrate to `guava` to receive updates and new features.
